claims.evidence: One source per (condition, SILAC mixture): each mixture combines equal volumes of conditioned medium from one Con, one LR and one LT culture (paper 2.4, PRIDE protocol). Mixtures are identified by the raw-file prefixes 070318_Sun_SILAC_Mix_1/2 and 111918_RAW_Sec_Mix_1/2; the A/B suffix is the injection (technical replicate). Each source name therefore denotes one culture supernatant measured in two injections.

claims.location: comment[label] rows 1-24; factor value[treatment] / characteristics[treatment] rows 1-24
claims.value: Con=SILAC light, LR=SILAC medium, LT=SILAC heavy
claims.evidence: Paper 2.4 and PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: "The first group contained control cells that received no LPS (NT/NT or Con) and were grown in cDMEM labeled with Arg0 and Lys0. The second group ... (NT/LPS or LR) ... labeled with Arg+6 and Lys+4. The third group ... (LPS/LPS or LT) ... labeled with Arg+10 and Lys+8." summary.txt: Multiplicity 3, Labels1 Arg6;Lys4 (medium), Labels2 Arg10;Lys8 (heavy). Ratio check (orientation.txt): Tnf log2 M/L +5.0..+5.7 and H/M -3.7..-4.1 in the four 070318 runs; Ccl4 M/L +2.4..+3.6 and H/M -3.0..-3.7 in all eight runs, i.e. the medium (LR) channel carries the LPS cytokine burst and the heavy (LT) channel the tolerant suppression, as the paper reports (TNF, Ccl4 in the LRU group, increased vs both Con and LT). No conflict between sources.

claims.value: 1-4 per treatment group (070318 Mix1=1, Mix2=2; 111918 Mix1=3, Mix2=4)
claims.evidence: Paper 2.4: "this method was repeated twice with two biological replicates each time to produce four biological replicates"; PRIDE: "Two sets of samples were prepared twice for 4 total biological replicates". Four mixtures deposited (two per date prefix). Each mixture holds one independent culture per condition, so numbers 1-4 restart in each treatment group. Mix1 vs Mix2 ratios differ (e.g. Tnf H/L 0.98 vs 1.77 in 070318) while A/B pairs agree to within 0.1 log2, consistent with Mix = biological, A/B = technical.

Paper 2.6: "Each biological replicate was analyzed twice to create two technical replicates"; PRIDE: "eight total replicates". Paired files *_A/*_B (or 1A/1B) per mixture; ratios of A/B pairs nearly identical in proteinGroups.txt.
All 8 RAW files in the PRIDE file list; all 8 appear as raw files of the single MaxQuant search (summary.txt). MQ_Results.zip (search output) and the FASTA are not data runs.
PRIDE organisms NEWT:10090; RAW 264.7 mouse macrophage cells (paper 2.1); Cellosaurus OX NCBI_TaxID=10090; OLS NCBITaxon:10090 Mus musculus.

claims.evidence: Raw instrument method (both 070318 and 111918 sets): full MS resolution 60,000, scan range 400 to 1600 m/z; dd-MS2 resolution 15,000 (Orbitrap; the Q Exactive HF has no ion trap), "(N)CE / stepped (N)CE nce: 27". Paper 2.6: HCD, NCE 27%, m/z 400-1600. The PRIDE protocol text (100,000 resolution, NCE 35%, ion-trap MS2) disagrees with both raw files and the paper and is not used.

Paper 2.5 / PRIDE: "The gel pieces were saturated with 13 ng/uL sequence-grade modified trypsin (Promega) ... incubated at 37 C overnight" (in-gel digestion). MaxQuant enzyme Trypsin/P is the search rule (batch rule 2).
Paper 2.5: "50 uL of 10 mM dithriothreitol (DTT)" and "50 uL of 55 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CA)". Carbamidomethyl (C) fixed in the search is consistent with chloroacetamide.

limitations: comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.6.3.3 parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record the first/main-search precursor tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited. Consequence: parse_sdrf convert-openms exits 1 ("Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available"), as for campaign precedents PXD014368/PXD006676/PXD024103.

Assignment of the four mixtures to the two preparation rounds (070318 vs 111918 prefixes) is inferred from the file-name dates and the different LC methods in the raw headers (176 min vs 140 min); the paper says only "repeated twice with two biological replicates each time". It does not affect replicate numbering (1-4 are unique per culture either way).

Deposited search vs. paper: MQ_Results parameters.txt reports MaxQuant 1.6.3.3, PSM/protein FDR 0.05, FASTA UniProt_10090_Sept2018_JG.fasta, variable Deamidation (NQ) and Phospho (STY) and no Acetyl (K); the paper/PRIDE state MaxQuant 1.6.5.0, FDR 0.01, FASTA downloaded 26.03.2019, and variable acetylation of lysine. The SDRF follows the deposited search output; the paper values may describe a different (undeposited) search.

PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol states MS1 resolution 100,000, NCE 35% and ion-trap MS2, and a 400 mm ProntoPEARL column; raw instrument methods of both preparation rounds and the paper say 60,000, NCE 27 and Orbitrap MS2 at 15,000. The raw files were followed.
